workspace.notificationBody.one: %1 app passed your storage-growth threshold. Open Alerts in Mosaic to review.
workspace.notificationBody.other: %1 apps passed your storage-growth threshold. Open Alerts in Mosaic to review.

workspace.historyOff: History is off. Enable it in Settings to keep local scan snapshots.
workspace.noHistory: No saved snapshots in this scope. Run a scan to start a baseline.
workspace.noComparable: No comparable growth yet. Two complete scans with unchanged ownership and accounting are needed. Unknown and partial sizes are never treated as zero.
workspace.filterHistory: Filter saved apps by name or ID…
workspace.historyBasis: Snapshot sizes, not growth. ≥ marks a partial lower bound. Deep and overview scans are kept separate.
workspace.chooseDeepApp: Choose an app above to view its deep-scan history.
workspace.reason.no-baseline: No earlier baseline for this scan scope.
workspace.reason.incomplete: A measurement is incomplete; exact growth is unavailable.
workspace.reason.accounting-changed: Shared accounting changed; these totals are not comparable.
workspace.reason.unmapped: No confidently mapped size is available.
workspace.mappingHelp: Assign a specific existing location to a discovered app. User-added means your assignment, not independently verified ownership.
workspace.removeHelp: Remove only forgets the association. Nothing on disk is deleted. Editing the same app and path updates its category.
workspace.insightsHelp: Confidently mapped caches and positive, comparable app growth. Sizes are logical bytes, not reclaimable space or deletion advice.
workspace.leftoversHelp: Possible only: an absent desktop launcher does not prove an app is uninstalled or its data safe to delete. Hidden launchers and command-line apps may still use it.
workspace.installationsHelp: Installed package sizes, separate from app data. Each package or deployment is counted once. Shared dependency packages and Flatpak runtimes are excluded.
workspace.alertsHelp: Saved threshold crossings from comparable completed scans. Reopening this panel does not send the same notification again.
workspace.notesHelp: Limits and diagnostics from the latest dashboard refresh.
workspace.noLeftovers: No possible leftovers identified. This is not proof that no other app data exists.
workspace.notRefreshed: Refresh the dashboard to inspect the current local inventory.
workspace.sharedPackage: Shared by these launchers · counted once
workspace.alertsOff: Growth notifications are off. Saved alerts remain visible.
workspace.reason.accounting-uncertain: Hard-link or shared accounting is uncertain; exact growth is unavailable.
workspace.reason.non-increasing-time: The scan timestamp does not follow the previous baseline.
workspace.reason.comparable: Complete measurements with comparable ownership and accounting.
workspace.notificationFailed: Growth alert saved, but its desktop notification could not be delivered.
visual.snapshotLegend: One bar per snapshot · empty mark = unknown · ≥ / tinted = partial
visual.dashboardHelp: Mapped logical bytes, not disk usage or reclaimable space. Categories share the same overview scan. Snapshot bars show recorded sizes, not growth; empty marks indicate unknown sizes and ≥ / tinted bars indicate partial lower bounds. Unmapped data is not counted.
visual.historyWindow: The display window changes only the plotted samples, not retention. Inspect the full retained list below the chart. At most 60 snapshots within 2 MiB are kept; older records may be removed. Bars are ordered by scan, not equally spaced time intervals.
visual.filterApps: Find a discovered or recorded app…
visual.cacheBasis: Measured mapped cache, not reclaimable space. Partial values are lower bounds; an absent measurement is never zero.
visual.noPackages: No installation records in this filter.
preferences.invalid: That display preference is not valid. Nothing was changed.
preferences.unavailable: Display settings are unavailable until the shell delivers this widget’s settings. Reopen the panel and try again.
preferences.rejected: The shell did not accept this display change. Check that Mosaic is still configured in the bar, then try again.
preferences.hexHelp: Enter a color as #RRGGBB, for example #80A0C0.
contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.openFailed: Could not open your browser. Please try again.
about.tagline: Know where your apps keep data.
preferences.mappingEmpty: Connect an existing location to an app. No application files are changed.
preferences.removeConfirm: Forget this association? The folder, its contents and the application stay untouched.
preferences.mappingIdentity: The app and path identify this association. To assign another location, add a separate mapping.
preferences.mappingSafety: Your assignment is not independently verified ownership. Saving starts a new scan; it never moves or deletes application files.
preferences.appUnavailable: This app is not in the current discovered inventory. Scan again before saving its mapping.
preferences.mappingNotSaved: The returned mappings did not confirm this change. Your fields have been kept; try again.
year.monthlyBasis: Last retained overview snapshot in each month
year.historyOffDetail: Only previously retained scans appear here. Enable recording in Settings for future snapshots.
year.emptyDetail: Recorded scans will appear here. Live storage never fills missing months.
year.deepOnly: This year has deep scans only. Their app measurements appear below, not in the overview bars.
year.daysDetail: Distinct local dates with retained scans
year.appsDetail: Distinct app IDs, including unknown sizes
year.retention: History keeps at most 60 scans within 2 MiB, not a complete year. Month bars are snapshots, never sums. Empty months stay empty; unknown measurements stay unknown.
year.comparisonBasis: Rise and fall compare adjacent scans of the same scope and app, with both dates in this year. Sizes must be known and complete, times increasing, and ownership and accounting signatures unchanged and safe. A fall is an observed decrease, not proof of cleanup.
year.measurementBasis: The footprint peak uses overview scans only. App and app-cache peaks may come from overview or deep scans; their scope and dates are shown. Lower bounds are marked ≥. Peaks rank measured bytes, not unknown actual sizes. Days use local calendar dates.
evidence.encounters: Counts are encountered entries or stops, not all files. Duplicate hard links count once. Samples below are relative paths, capped at 8; … marks a truncated path.
scan.lowerBoundHelp: ≥ means at least this much. Some data was not measured.
scan.scopeHelp: Only identified candidates are measured—not all app data or reclaimable space. Possible and shared matches are excluded from mapped bytes. Categories describe folders, not contents.
preferences.historyConsent: Local summaries · up to 60 scans / 2 MiB
preferences.alertConsent: Notify when comparable growth crosses the threshold.
preferences.alertRequiresHistory: Enable history to use growth alerts.
preferences.thresholdUnconfirmed: The threshold was not confirmed. Your value is kept; try saving again.
preferences.clearSafety: Clear saved snapshots and alerts? Application files, settings and mappings stay untouched.
category.tileDescription: %1 measured in this category. Select to inspect locations.
category.otherDescription: %1 measured across grouped apps. Select to open their app picker.
category.help: Tile area represents measured bytes in this category, not disk capacity or reclaimable space. Only known app locations contribute. Zero-byte and unmeasured apps remain available in All apps. Possible and shared matches are disclosed separately, never counted as owned storage. ≥ marks a lower bound.
category.empty: No known app locations in this category yet.
category.unmeasured: Locations are known, but their sizes are not measured yet.
category.zero: Measured locations contain no bytes. Use All apps to inspect their locations.
category.mapHint: Area = measured bytes · select an app to inspect
category.otherHelp: Apps grouped into the Other tile. All apps also includes zero-byte and unmeasured apps.
category.pickerHelp: Every app with a known location in this category, including zero-byte and unmeasured apps.
category.excludedHelp: Excluded candidate matches — not owned storage. Possible or shared locations never contribute to the total or tiles. The same physical location may match several apps.
scan.coverage.title: Candidate matches
scan.countsHelp: Counts are reported skipped encounters or scan stops, not unique files or all unseen data. Repeated candidate matches can repeat counts. — means no count was reported.
scan.coverageHelp: Each segment counts candidate matches; the same physical location can match more than once. Fully read, partial / unread and pending describe assigned matches. Unassigned includes possible and shared matches, regardless of read status. Unknown contents have no known size or percentage.
scan.bytesHelp: File lengths, not allocated disk blocks or recoverable space.
scan.unknownHelp: Bounded walks can stop early. ≥ marks the measured lower bound; unread contents have no inferred size.
preferences.privacyHelp: No scheduled scans. Update checks contact GitHub and may download a stable release into private staging. Automatic preparation is opt-in; installation always requires approval to restart the whole Omarchy shell. No application or storage data is sent. Your application files stay read-only. Mosaic saves its own settings, history, updater state and private recovery backups. Chart samples changes the displayed range, not the retention limit.
preferences.chartWindowHint: Choose how many saved snapshots charts show.
preferences.privacyHint: Local storage and network access explained.
preferences.thresholdHint: Notify when an app grows by this amount.
preferences.savedDataHint: Clear local history without changing application files.
updates.title: Updates
updates.disclosure:
Checks stable GitHub releases and prepares newer code.
Installation needs explicit shell-restart approval.
updates.privacy: Checks may download code. No app data sent; never installs automatically.
updates.error.timeout: The operation timed out. Check again or read Details.
updates.error.response: Update status could not be read. Refresh to see whether installation started.
updates.manualBuild: This local build needs manual installation.
updates.waitForIdle: Finish the current operation before restarting.
updates.restartWarning: Restarts the entire Omarchy shell, briefly stopping other plugins. Mosaic settings and history are backed up.
updates.approvalChanged: The prepared update changed. Review it again before installing.
